description: ANAC open data (dados abertos) is a data repository run by Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (ANAC), found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. Open data page of the Brazilian civil aviation agency. Coverage: Brasil. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Dados Abertos — Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac)". Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Brasil.
